title: A Mixed-Signal Photonic SRAM-based High-Speed Energy-Efficient Photonic Tensor Core with Novel Electro-Optic ADC
problem: Traditional electrical von Neumann architectures suffer from memory-compute data movement bottlenecks and rising bitline/wordline capacitance at advanced nodes, limiting throughput and efficiency for AI/ML workloads.
motivation: IoT, AI, and ML applications generate massive data but conventional transistor-based memory architectures become increasingly energy-inefficient due to interconnect resistance and crosstalk at scale.
method: A differential photonic SRAM (pSRAM) bitcell augments a scalable mixed-signal photonic tensor core for matrix multiplication using monolithic integrated photonic components. A novel 1-hot encoding electro-optic ADC (eoADC) converts multiplication outputs to digital bitstreams for electrical domain processing, eliminating memory-compute data movement bottleneck.
key_novelty: First photonic tensor core with integrated pSRAM bitcell and novel 1-hot electro-optic ADC, achieving ultra-fast tera-scale computation with high energy efficiency via in-memory photonic processing.
contributions: Differential photonic SRAM bitcell for scalable photonic tensor core matrix multiplication.
Novel 1-hot encoding electro-optic ADC for efficient photonic-to-electrical conversion.
4.10 TOPS and 3.02 TOPS/W on GlobalFoundries 45SPCLO node, demonstrating photonics advantage over electronics.
primary_theme: photonic tensor core with in-memory processing
